name: Bounce Cat
storyline:
Kat and Mat were two inseparable cats living peacefully with their humans in a warm, cozy home. But one day, everything changed. A mysterious figure appeared out of nowhere, unleashed a magical explosion that shattered their home, and fled upward into a surreal vertical world—taking Mat along.
Now, surrounded by floating debris and bouncing orbs, Kat must climb through this strange new realm, relying only on her agility, determination… and feline instinct. There's no turning back—she has to save Mat.
summary: Bounce Cat is a vertical platformer where every jump matters and every fall hurts. Join Kat, a determined cat on a mission to rescue her companion Mat, as she climbs through a challenging vertical world. There are no traditional checkpoints—just pure skill, precise bounces, and the occasional break… by meowing a little tune.
